seoTitle: How to List Multiple Sizes on eBay Using Variations (2026)
metaDescription: Learn how to add size, color, and material variations to an eBay listing from the iPhone app and desktop site, plus how to manage stock per size.
intro: If you sell clothing, shoes, or anything with multiple options, listing every size as its own separate item wastes time and clutters your store. eBay's variation listings let you combine sizes, colors, or materials into one product page, and this guide covers how to set that up from both the iPhone app and the desktop Seller Hub.

steps.heading: Enable item specifics for your product
steps.body: Before adding variations, set the relevant item specifics — size, color, or material — so eBay recognizes these as selectable options for buyers.

steps.heading: Turn on variations in the listing flow
steps.body: When creating or editing a listing, activate the multi-variation option so you can add several sizes or colors under a single listing instead of creating duplicates.

steps.heading: Add each size or color option
steps.body: Fill in the specific values for each variation — for example, small, medium, and large — along with photos for each option where relevant.

steps.heading: Set stock levels per variation
steps.body: Assign quantity and, if needed, price per individual size or color so your inventory stays accurate as different variations sell.

steps.heading: List from the iPhone app or desktop site
steps.body: The variation process works from both eBay's mobile app on iPhone and the desktop Seller Hub, so you can choose whichever is more convenient when creating a listing.

faq.question: Can I add size variations from the eBay iPhone app?
faq.answer: Yes, the mobile app supports adding variations like size and color directly during the listing process, not just the desktop site.

faq.question: Do I need separate photos for each size?
faq.answer: It's recommended for color variations especially, since buyers often want to see the actual option they're choosing, though it's not always required for every size.

faq.question: Can I set different stock levels for each size?
faq.answer: Yes, each variation can have its own quantity so you can track which sizes are selling out without affecting the rest of the listing.

faq.question: What categories support variation listings on eBay?
faq.answer: Clothing, shoes, and other items with size, color, or material options are the most common categories that support this feature.
